title: Tensor counit compatibility with one K-flat representative
statement: Let $k:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the recorded derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $P$ and $G$ be cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and suppose $P$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $\tau$ satisfy the canonical pullback tensor comparison predicate [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Write $H=\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes G)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and $\epsilon_k$ for the universal counit [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. There exist isomorphisms $a:Q(P)\otimes^LQ(G)\cong Q(H)$ and $b:Q(k^*H)\cong Lk^*Q(P)\otimes^LQ(k^*G)$ such that $Lk^*(a);\epsilon_k(H);b=\tau(Q(P),Q(G));(Lk^*Q(P)\otimes\epsilon_k(G))$. No K-flatness or boundedness is assumed on $G$.

proof.text: Construct the total-complex chain isomorphism from derivedPullback_tensorProduct. The localization tensor map with first factor P is invertible by K-flatness and the derived monoidal counit computation, giving a. Pullback preserves K-flatness; the analogous localization map on T and the shared universal counit at P are invertible. Their inverses composed with the chain isomorphism define b. The shared counit computation follows from uniqueness of left-derived functors, comparing with the K-flat counit of exists_derivedPullback.

Apply the raw tensor counit coordinate equation to the chain comparison, whose prescribed summand equations are supplied by derivedPullback_tensorProduct. Normalize its identity object casts. This step requires neither G nor its ordinary pullback to be K-flat.

Postcompose the raw equation with the inverse target localization tensor map and the tensor of the inverse counit at P with the identity. Cancel the two isomorphisms using associativity and tensorHom composition. The resulting equation is precisely the displayed equation for a and b.

proof_origin.note: Explicit representative isomorphisms and tensor cancellation proved in Lean; arbitrary-complex raw counit coherence split off as a separate equation.
